title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions on Israeli basketball history, European football nights and an Olympic swimmer's near-miss in Paris.

questions.question: What is the best-ever finish by Israel's men's national basketball team in EuroBasket history?
questions.explanation: Israel won silver at EuroBasket 1979, losing the final 98-76 to the Soviet Union in Turin, still its highest-ever finish as of 2025.

questions.question: By what aggregate score did Hapoel Tel Aviv beat GKS Katowice to reach the Conference League playoff round?
questions.explanation: Hapoel Tel Aviv won 2-0 in the first leg and lost the second 2-1 in Poland, advancing 3-2 on aggregate.

questions.question: Where did Israeli swimmer Daria Golovaty finish in the 200m freestyle semi-finals at the 2026 European Aquatics Championships in Paris, missing the final?
questions.explanation: Golovaty clocked 1:58.48 in the semi-final to finish 14th overall, just outside the final.

questions.question: Goalkeeper Omer Niraon, who has just joined Maccabi Haifa on loan from Maccabi Netanya, represented Israel at which Olympics?
questions.explanation: Niraon represented Israel in goal at the 2024 Paris Olympics before his loan move to Maccabi Haifa as back-up to Omri Glazer.

questions.question: Beitar Jerusalem striker Shon Weissman was the Austrian Bundesliga's top scorer in 2019-20 with 30 goals while playing for which club?
questions.explanation: Weissman topped the Austrian Bundesliga scoring charts with Wolfsberger AC in 2019-20 before rejoining Beitar Jerusalem this summer, who now face Austria Wien in the Conference League.
